service: The AWS Lambda Web Functions APIs (LambdaWeb namespace) are experimental and for internal AWS use only. They are not yet available to external customers.

operations.GetWebAccountSettings:
Retrieves details about your AWS Lambda Web Functions account settings for the current AWS Region, including the quotas that apply to web functions and your current usage.

This API is experimental and for internal AWS use only. It is not yet available to external customers.

AccessDeniedException.base: You do not have sufficient permissions to perform this operation.

AccountQuotas.base: The quotas that apply to web functions in your account in the current AWS Region.

refs.GetWebAccountSettingsResponse$accountQuo: The quotas that apply to web functions in your account in the current AWS Region.

refs.AccountQuotas$maxEndpointsPerFunction: The maximum number of endpoints that a single web function can have.

refs.AccountQuotas$maxRevisionsPerFunction: The maximum number of revisions that a single web function can have.

refs.AccountQuotas$maxTotalArmVCpus: The maximum total number of Arm vCPUs that you can allocate across all of your web functions in the current AWS Region.

refs.AccountQuotas$maxTotalRateLimit: The maximum number of requests per second allowed across all of your web function endpoints in your account in the current AWS Region.

AccountUsage.base: Contains your current web function usage for the current AWS Region.

refs.GetWebAccountSettingsResponse$accountUsa: The current web function usage for your account in the current AWS Region.

refs.AccountUsage$functionCount: The number of web functions in your account in the current AWS Region.

GetWebAccountSettingsResponse.base: Contains your AWS Lambda Web Functions account quotas and usage for the current AWS Region.

refs.ThrottlingException$retryAfterSeconds: The number of seconds to wait before retrying the request.

InternalServerException.base: An internal server error occurred. Try again later.

refs.AccessDeniedException$message: A message describing the access denied error.
refs.ThrottlingException$serviceCode: The service code of the throttled service.
refs.ThrottlingException$quotaCode: The quota code that was exceeded, if applicable.

ThrottlingException.base: The request was throttled. Reduce the frequency of requests and try again.
